---
title: "Data preparation and tools"
subtitle: "From raw fishery data to inputs an assessment or indicator can trust"
---

Most assessment problems start in the data: unstandardised CPUE, incomplete catches and unrepresentative length samples bias any method, however well it is chosen. This pillar of the toolbox covers everything that happens **before** a method is run. It sits alongside the assessment catalogue, not underneath it, because the same prepared data feed several methods and the weight of evidence across methods.

::: {.ws-grid}
::: {.ws-card style="--ws:#1f6a8a"}

#### [Data preparation workflow](data-preparation.qmd)
Data inventory and timeline of events, life-history inventory, database set-up, cleaning and outliers, exploratory analysis. Based on FAO Technical Paper 706, with Excel templates.
:::
::: {.ws-card style="--ws:#2e7d4f"}
[Abundance indices]{.ws-num}

#### [cpueTargeting](cpuetargeting.qmd)
CPUE standardisation for multispecies and multi-tactic fisheries, in nine steps from the raw logbook to an index with SE, with simulation tests of targeting.
:::
::: {.ws-card style="--ws:#c4552b"}
[Length and biology]{.ws-num}

#### [FishualizeR](fishualizer.qmd)
Interactive quality control, coverage and binning of length data; companion app to Technical Paper 706.
:::
::: {.ws-card style="--ws:#6b4fa0"}
[Combining indices]{.ws-num}

#### [JARA](jara.qmd)
Joint index from several noisy series with missing years; trend and decline rates.
